review.summary: The 14384-triangle wall lamp retains the diffuser housing, caps, mounting plate and open connecting supports. Finished PBR remains close to the approved source across primary front/side/rear views, and fresh FBX/GLB checks pass.

issues.problem: Neutral-only surface softening and minor fastener/edge rounding after reduction.

review.summary: Warm pale diffuser, dark bronze housing/caps and mounting hardware are clearly separated in the primary front/opposite and side views. The rear mount remains complete with plausible inferred inner pads, and no unwanted text or broad texture defects are visible.

issues.problem: Diffuser is less luminous than the lit reference and the concealed rear has pale inferred pads. This is a static material asset; runtime light/emission setup is separate.

review.summary: Tall rectangular diffuser housing, upper/lower caps, separate mounting backplate and two connecting supports match the reference wall lamp. Both front and rear construction are complete with open spacing between housing and backplate.

issues.problem: Tiny seam/fastener irregularities and softer housing corners than the reference.
